finding.observed: The provenance coverage validator previously accepted coverage_result independently of the underlying ref_inventory.complete, history_traversal.complete, and known_exclusions fields except during unlocated transitions.
finding.inferred: A receipt could overstate or contradict its actual search surface while retaining unresolved or located transitions, weakening provenance guarantees.
finding.proposed: Treat coverage_result as a derived semantic classification: complete requires complete ref inventory, complete history traversal, and no exclusions; complete_with_declared_exclusions requires both structural traversals complete and at least one explicit exclusion; incomplete cannot coexist with both traversals complete and zero exclusions.
finding.superseded: The coverage_result label alone is sufficient evidence of coverage class.
finding.unresolved: M-004, M-005, and M-006 remain unresolved pending authenticated exhaustive repository coverage and immutable source-location evidence.

verification.method: static inspection of committed validator and deterministic Node test additions
verification.claim_boundary: The committed tests specify falsification cases, but this run did not obtain an authenticated runtime execution result.

falsification_route: Run node --test operations/continuity/tools/validate-provenance-coverage-receipt.test.mjs in an authenticated checkout and reject this slice if any test fails.
